description: Decodes an OpenID Connect ID token and checks its issuer and audience claims. Does not verify the token's cryptographic signature — only use after obtaining the token directly from the provider's token endpoint over TLS.
label: Inspect ID Token

options.name: id-token
options.label: ID Token
options.info: The id_token returned by the identity provider's token endpoint

options.name: expected-issuer
options.label: Expected Issuer
options.info: The value the token's "iss" claim must exactly match, e.g. https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant-id}/v2.0

options.name: expected-audience
options.label: Expected Audience
options.info: The value that must be present in the token's "aud" claim — normally your application's client ID

options.name: schemaModel
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: Optionally type the claims output so later steps can bind directly to fields like claims.email

options.name: claims
options.label: Claims
options.info: Every claim from the decoded ID token, e.g. claims.email, claims.preferred_username, claims.sub
